say:2:1360012001:0.text: Hah, what a battle! Well fought, indeed! Now, rest your weary bones.
say:2:1360012001:0.source_cn: 哈哈，痛快痛快！几位，快坐下好好休息！
say:2:1360012001:0.male: Hah, what a battle! Well fought, indeed! Now, rest your weary bones.
say:2:1360012001:0.female: Hah, what a battle! Well fought, indeed! Now, rest your weary bones.

say:3:1360012002:1.text: You've journeyed far. If not to test your might in our tournament, then what brings you here?
say:3:1360012002:1.source_cn: 各位专程过来一趟，如果不是为了参加我们的比武，那是有什...

say:4:1360012003:1.text: Upon hearing you explain the situation, Kruger strikes his chest and nods firmly.
say:4:1360012003:1.source_cn: 告知来意后，克鲁格立刻豪爽地拍着胸脯答应了我们。

say:5:1360012004:0.text: Fear not! This is but a small task. We have plenty of furs to spare!
say:5:1360012004:0.source_cn: 放心吧！这点小事，你们要什么毛皮，我们有的是！

say:6:1360012005:0.text: And if need be, we shall have the losers of the tournament shave their heads!
say:6:1360012005:0.source_cn: 大不了就让比赛输了的那几个蛮血剃个光头！

say:12:1360012008:1.text: Ah, Mikola. Is something troubling you?
say:12:1360012008:1.source_cn: 怎么了，曼卡拉？有什么事？

say:13:1360012009:1.text: Actually, for this year's Emberlight Duel, I'm planning to create a brand-new batch of fireworks that'll take the atmosphere to a whole new level.
say:13:1360012009:1.source_cn: 其实，今年的春焰比武，我计划要做些全新的烟花来衬托气氛！

say:14:1360012010:1.text: Say goodbye to the same old fireworks we've been seeing year after year at the Warsong Festival, the Fall Harvest, and even the Winter Carnival. People are just so over them...
say:14:1360012010:1.source_cn: 过去的烟火连着放了那么久，战歌节也放，秋夜节也放，隆冬...

say:17:1360012011:1.text: Personally, I think if there were fewer tournaments, people wouldn't get bored...
say:17:1360012011:1.source_cn: 我是觉得，你们少比几次武，就不会看腻了……

say:18:1360012012:1.text: But since Merlin's here, maybe—just maybe—he could work his magic and come up with some wild new colors for the fireworks at the Emberlight Festival!
say:18:1360012012:1.source_cn: 既然梅林来了，能否请大魔法师大人，为我们的春焰庆，调配...
say:18:1360012012:1.male: But since Merlin's here, maybe—just maybe—he could work his magic and come up with some wild new colors for the fireworks at the Emberlight Festival!
say:18:1360012012:1.female: But since Merlin's here, maybe—just maybe—she could work her magic and come up with some wild new colors for the fireworks at the Emberlight Festival!

say:19:1360012013:1.text: Woah, you just turned into a pro narrator there! So persuasive!
say:19:1360012013:1.source_cn: 哇，瞬间就变成解说口吻了，好有煽动性！

say:20:1360012014:0.text: But wait, no magic will make fireworks without gunpowder!
say:20:1360012014:0.source_cn: 不过，烟花这种东西，颜色还能用炼金的方式处理，但还是需...

say:21:1360012015:0.text: Don't worry, there's more than enough! I've been prepping for this festival since the start of the year! We're good to go!
say:21:1360012015:0.source_cn: 放心，火药管够！为了这次春焰庆，我可是很早之前就开始准备了！

say:22:1360012016:1.text: Just as Mikola's running through all the cool stuff she's planned for the festival, a timid voice breaks in.
say:22:1360012016:1.source_cn: 正在曼卡拉激情四射地阐述她为节日做的准备时，一个声音弱...

say:25:1360012017:1.text: S-sorry... It's just, the gunpowder might, um... be a little short.
say:25:1360012017:1.source_cn: 抱、抱歉……可能，我是说，火药，可能，那个，有点不够了。

say:26:1360012018:0.text: What?! I've been stockpiling barrels of gunpowder all year! How can we be running low?
say:26:1360012018:0.source_cn: 什么？！那么多，我准备了那么多桶！从年初就开始准备，怎...

say:27:1360012019:0.text: Did it get damp? Or spoil? Impossible, this is the desert—
say:27:1360012019:0.source_cn: 受潮？还是变质？！不可能呀，这里是沙漠——

say:28:1360012020:1.text: Uh... No... It's just that I sometimes need some for incense... so I took a little from the stash...
say:28:1360012020:1.source_cn: 呃，是，是我平时做香薰会需要从仓库里取一点……

say:29:1360012021:1.text: But when I saw how much was sitting there unused, I thought, hey, maybe I can sell just a bit and replace it later.
say:29:1360012021:1.source_cn: 但我看仓库里囤了那么多，从年初就没什么人用，我想着就偷...

say:30:1360012022:0.text: But... then it got stolen by some bandits...
say:30:1360012022:0.source_cn: 结果之前“零售”的时候，就，不小心被那些强盗们给抢走了……

say:31:1360012023:2.text: I only took a little, though!

say:32:1360012024:1.text: If it was just a little bit, it shouldn't make a difference, right? You don't need to test every mix, so maybe we can make do with what's left...
say:32:1360012024:1.source_cn: 如果只丢了一点点，应该影响也不大吧？主人的调配不需要测...

say:33:1360012025:0.text: Despite everyone trying to calm her down, Mikola is not having it.
say:33:1360012025:0.source_cn: 面对我们的劝解，曼卡拉却怒火更盛。

say:34:1360012026:0.text: Tell me the truth! Was it just a little lost, or is there just a "little" left?!
say:34:1360012026:0.source_cn: 你……老实说！到底是丢了一点点，还是只剩一点点！

say:37:1360012028:1.text: You! You always take advantage of situations like this! This time, I'm NOT letting you off the hook!
say:37:1360012028:1.source_cn: 你这家伙，每次都这么贪小便宜！这次绝对不能放过你！

say:38:1360012029:1.text: Enough, Mikola. Scolding Smokey now will serve no purpose. First, we must recover the gunpowder.
say:38:1360012029:1.source_cn: 算了，曼卡拉，现在骂阿熏也无济于事，我们先要把火药抢回来。

say:39:1360012030:1.text: If it falls into the hands of those bandits, it will be a great danger.
say:39:1360012030:1.source_cn: 否则，落在那些强盗手里，危害可是非常大的。

say:43:1360012032:1.text: Words are not enough. You must feel the consequences of your actions. Let me think... The materials for the fireworks will be your responsibility.
say:43:1360012032:1.source_cn: 光道歉可没有用，这次得让你足够肉疼才行……我想想，焰火...

say:44:1360012033:0.text: All the colors and ingredients. If spices are needed, and if the incense for the Emberlight Duel is required, you will cover those expenses as well.
say:44:1360012033:0.source_cn: 里面如果需要掺上香料，春焰比武需要的熏香，也都由你买单。

say:45:1360012034:0.text: W-what? Selling off a whole warehouse of gunpowder wouldn't cover—
say:45:1360012034:0.source_cn: 这、这这，这卖掉几库的火药都——

say:47:1360012036:1.text: You support Meerky and handle your daily burdens. I understand it is no easy task.
say:47:1360012036:1.source_cn: 你带着蒙蒙，平时开销大，生活不容易，我们都知道。

say:48:1360012037:1.text: But this... this is not a small matter. Selling fake medicine, diluting potions, and cutting corners here and there is mere mischief.
say:48:1360012037:1.source_cn: 平时卖点假药，兑点水，贪小便宜，这些只是小打小闹。

say:49:1360012038:1.text: But this time, you've crossed the line. Considering Merlin's presence and the approaching Emberlight Festival, I will allow you to atone in this way... this time only.
say:49:1360012038:1.source_cn: 像这次这样就太过分了，看在梅林的面子上，以及春焰庆将至...

say:51:1360012040:0.text: I swear... I will never do this again! I'll cover all the costs this time!
say:51:1360012040:0.source_cn: 绝、绝对不会再犯了！这次的所有费用，我、我全包了！

say:55:1360012041:1.text: With his head lowered, looking utterly defeated, Smokey goes off to gather the spices.
say:55:1360012041:1.source_cn: 阿熏哭丧着脸，垂头丧气地去筹办香料了。

say:56:1360012042:1.text: Lord Brutus, you're so dignified and strong!
say:56:1360012042:1.source_cn: 布鲁特斯大人真是又威严又帅气！

say:57:1360012043:0.text: Haha, with Smokey... even if you give him a beating, his medical skills ensure the pain is fleeting.
say:57:1360012043:0.source_cn: 呵呵，也是因为阿熏这小子，揍他一顿，他凭着那手医术也不...

say:58:1360012044:0.text: If you wish to teach him a true lesson, aim for the weak spot—that, too, is a form of combat.
say:58:1360012044:0.source_cn: 要让他刻骨铭心，就得瞄准要害——这也算是一点战斗技巧吧。

say:59:1360012045:0.text: As for the stolen gunpowder, I had planned to retrieve it myself, but with the tournament preparations...
say:59:1360012045:0.source_cn: 至于那些遗失的火药，本来应该我亲自去把他们抓回来，但现...

choice_prompt:60:1360012045.text: As for the stolen gunpowder, I had planned to retrieve it myself, but with the tournament preparations...
choice_prompt:60:1360012045.source_cn: 至于那些遗失的火药，本来应该我亲自去把他们抓回来，但现在比武的事务……

say:61:1360012046:0.text: Then I place this task in your capable hands. Thank you. I will prepare what you need without delay.
say:61:1360012046:0.source_cn: 那就拜托了，感谢诸位，你们需要的东西，我也会尽快准备好的。
